statements.status_notes: Docker Scout and the npm registry list no release newer than 1.1.3, and the advisory reports no patched version. sprintf-js is a transitive runtime dependency of the Uptime Kuma Node application. Impact and reachability of the improper quantity validation flaw are under assessment until upstream publishes a fix.
